notes: Access: direct fetch worked (HTTP 200, no WAF/geo-block), robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Site is Shopify (myborosil.com). Used /collections/<handle>/products.json (paginated, limit=250) as the exact-count source rather than the storefront's rounded/estimated widgets. Borosil's catalogue heavily cross-tags the same product into multiple nav collections (e.g. a tea-cup SKU appears in both 'dinnerware' and 'drinkware'); the raw per-collection counts (e.g. dinnerware=371, drinkware=823) therefore cannot be summed directly without double-counting. Fixed this by fetching products.json across 26 relevant collections, deduplicating by Shopify product id (1718 unique in-scope-candidate products out of a site-wide total of 3076 products per sitemap), then grouping by the site's own product_type field to produce non-overlapping qty buckets -- every leaf qty below is an exact sum of one or more product_type buckets, verified programmatically (bucket sum = 1643, excluded-item sum = 75, 1643+75=1718 matches the deduped unique-product total exactly). SCOPE DECISIONS: (1) Cookware, kitchen appliances (OTG/air fryer/gas stove/mixer/electric kettles/tea kettles), cutlery, bar tools, spare parts/accessories and 'Deals' collections were never fetched / excluded entirely per the appliance/cookware/cutlery exclusion. (2) Non-glass Bottles (stainless steel/copper/thermoware) and non-glass Lunchboxes (stainless steel) were excluded as out-of-scope personal hydration/food-carry houseware; only the Borosilicate GLASS bottle and glass lunchbox lines were kept, matching the brief's 'focus purely on decorative/tableware glass items'. (3) 'Virtual Bundle' product_type (28 products) excluded as unverifiable mixed roll-ups (bundle contents not individually confirmable at listing level). (4) Placemats (textile), Puja Thali+Samagri sets (religious ritual set with consumables), Scented Candles and the Brass Diffuser (Home Fragrance exclusion), and a Backpack bundle SKU (bag) were excluded. (5) Diyas (Akhand Diya + Aarti Diya, qty 10) were judged IN SCOPE as decorative brass/nickel lamp objects analogous to 'candle holders' per RULE 0 (product type over name/context) -- this is a judgment call flagged here for reviewer override if the batch intends a stricter reading. HOME DECOR ABSENCE CHECK: used Shopify's /search/suggest.json endpoint to confirm zero results site-wide for mirror, lamp, lighting (fixture sense), wall art, planter, clock, sculpture, figurine, centerpiece -- Borosil's Home Decor footprint is confirmed limited to Vases and Diyas only, consistent with it being a glassware/houseware manufacturer, not a decor retailer. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: Borosil (myborosil.com) is a distinct, singular well-known Indian brand (Borosilicate Glass Works); no evidence of this being a duplicate of another company already processed in this batch.
